source_discrepancies.finding: CounterTypeCount maps each controlled creature to its count of positive counter kinds and sums. Oracle requires the number of distinct kinds in their union. Three creatures each with +1/+1 counters must count as one kind, not three.
source_discrepancies.resolution: Implement union using CounterKind::ALL and borrowed actual/speculative counter queries; test same-kind-on-three-creatures and three-kinds-on-one-creature boundaries. Oracle takes precedence.
